target_customer: Technical teams and companies that want a customizable, self-hostable CRM instead of Salesforce
problem: Incumbent CRMs are expensive, closed and hard to customize, so teams want an open source, modern alternative.
business_model: Open source core with paid cloud seats per user per month and enterprise tier

founders.name: Felix Malfait
founders.background_notes: Named CEO in the Silicon Canals report; no background found in opened sources.

founders.name: Thomas des Francs
founders.background_notes: Spelled Colas des Francs in press.

investors: Founders of HubSpot, Front, Cal.com, Sentry, Photoroom

competitors.name: Attio
competitors.what: Flexible data-model CRM for the Airtable generation

technical_complexity.rationale: A CRM with custom objects, views, permissions and workflows is standard engineering, with hard parts in flexible data modeling and self-hosting.

defensibility.rationale: Open source and copyable; moat is community and customer data lock-in. The site cites over 10k users.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied or acquired it by 2026; Salesforce and HubSpot remain dominant.

market_need_then: Teams complained about Salesforce cost and rigidity, and open source CRMs such as SuiteCRM and EspoCRM were seen as dated.

branding.domain_note: Holds the exact twenty.com domain; acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: Clean modern interface described as built to feel like Notion, with dark mode

branding.community_and_virality: Strong GitHub following reported by aggregators at about 44k stars (unverified); TechCrunch and Slashdot coverage in November 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: Open source community pull and press coverage, but name origin and brand assets are not documented.

outcome_analysis: Twenty rode open source distribution on GitHub and a clear Salesforce alternative pitch to a 5 million dollar seed led by Runa Capital in November 2024, then shipped 2.0 in April 2026. Customer logos on its site suggest growing adoption, but no later round was found.
notes: A French report cited in search results mentions a 2023 pre-seed and an aggregator lists a 500K YC amount; both unverified and not recorded as rounds. Total funding figures conflict across aggregators. 44k stars figure is from an aggregator. Competitors Attio and Folk are dated by launch coverage before the batch.
